content: I don't have a preference. Use the defaults you recommend, keep it free with no API keys, and carry on without me.

Nothing has changed since my last reply, and gbrain still isn't installed. Defaults and API keys aren't the problem. Hermes's security scanner blocks the install command, and "carry on" doesn't count as lifting that block. I won't change your approval setting or install the same package some other way without a clear yes from you. Running the command again would just get blocked again.

There are two ways to finish:

1. Reply with exactly "approve installs". I'll turn on `approvals.single_query_mode: approve` in config.yaml, then install v0.60.734.0 and set up a free local brain with keyword search and no API keys. I'll also connect it to Hermes, test it, and report what it returns. That setting stays on for later one-shot runs until you turn it off.

2. Paste the six-line command block from my previous reply into your terminal. It does the same thing.
